epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce manual database edits for material corrections from 5 per week to 0 per week
epics.tocConstraintRef: Material API incompleteness bottlenecking content updates
requirements: R1: The system must support updating existing epidemiological material records via the Material API.
R2: The system must support deleting existing epidemiological material records via the Material API.

slices.title: Patch Material API with Update and Delete Endpoints
slices.jtbd: When implementing update and delete for this epic, I want to patch the existing API controller, so that the material collection remains accurate and organized.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material record in the database
When a client sends a PUT request with updated data to the existing Material API
Then the material is correctly updated in the database
Given an existing material record in the database
When a client sends a DELETE request to the existing Material API
Then the material is removed from the system and verified by integration tests
slices.tocConstraintRef: Missing update and delete handlers in Material Controller
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase update and delete operation test coverage from 0% to 100%

epics.title: Authentication and Session Management Patch
epics.jtbd: When an authorized health professional accesses the epidemiological knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that only authorized personnel can add, modify, or view sensitive protocols.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthorized access incidents from 50 per week to 0 per week
epics.tocConstraintRef: Lack of security controls exposing sensitive knowledge base data
requirements: R1: The system must enforce valid credentials for accessing sensitive endpoints.
R2: The system must grant an authenticated session with appropriate role-based permissions.

slices.title: Patch Authentication and Role-Based Session Logic
slices.jtbd: When implementing authentication for this epic, I want to patch the existing security configuration, so that only authorized personnel can add, modify, or view sensitive protocols.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user attempting to access the system
When they request a protected endpoint without valid credentials
Then access is denied and a 401 Unauthorized response is returned
Given a user attempting to access the system
When they provide valid credentials
Then they are granted an authenticated session with appropriate role-based permissions and verified by integration tests
slices.tocConstraintRef: Unrestricted access in application security configuration
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase authentication test coverage on protected endpoints from 0% to 100%
